lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in approximately four parallel horizontal rows, located posterior to the fifth gill slit and dorsal to the pectoral fin attachment point.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the horizontal rows of blobs, creating a grid-like pattern where the blobs serve as nodes at the intersections.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A distinct longitudinal ridge feature is present on the upper lateral flank, characterized by a sharp vertical intensity gradient with high luminance on the dorsal side and a corresponding shadow-induced low-luminance zone on the ventral side.
